engines.name: Yandex
engines.description: Yandex web search. Choose yandex.com or ya.ru, a safe-search level, result language and region in the engine settings. Uses the curl transport by default because Yandex blocks Bun's fetch.

engines.name: Yandex Images
engines.description: Yandex image search. No query-level keyword blocks, safe-search level with unblurred thumbnails when off, size, type and layout filters.

engines.name: Yandex Visual Search
engines.description: Yandex reverse image search. Upload an image or use the image tab to find pages containing it and similar images. Adult results are not blocked when safe search is off.

engines.name: Yandex Videos
engines.description: Yandex video search. No query-level keyword blocks, safe-search level, and unblurred NSFW results when safe search is off.
